title: Generalised stochastic curvature flow in $d \geq 2$, and sharp interface limit for the stochastic Allen-Cahn equation with nonlinear diffusion
summary: We construct the local-in-time solution of the generalised anisotropic direction-dependent curvature flow in dimension $d \geq 2$ forced by a white-in-time and smooth-in-space Gaussian noise. This seems to be the first construction with a white-in-time noise which also allows spatial dependence, even in the simpler case of isotropic stochastic mean curvature flow. The main difficulty is that the stochastic PDE describing the flow has a multiplicative noise depending nonlinearly on both the solution and its gradient.
